prompt: Esme closed her laptop and (to tell) the actors about the theatre festival.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу указывается адресат (the actors) без предлога to.

prompt: Ursula quietly (to say) to Wanda that she hated museum audio tours.
explanation_ru: Глагол say требует предлога to перед адресатом (said to Wanda).

prompt: Simona ___ her brother that she had spilled soup on her shirt.
explanation_ru: После tell адресат (her brother) идёт напрямую без предлога; вариант said требует предлога to.

prompt: Did Willa (to say / to tell) the band that the radio show wanted them?
explanation_ru: Есть прямое указание на слушателей (the band) без предлога to, поэтому нужен глагол tell.

prompt: Rosa said me that the huge box held only one tiny doorbell button.
answer: Rosa told me that the huge box held only one tiny doorbell button.
accepted_answers: Rosa told me that the huge box held only one tiny doorbell button.
Rosa said to me that the huge box held only one tiny doorbell button.
explanation_ru: Нельзя сказать «said me»: нужен либо глагол told без предлога (told me), либо предлог to (said to me).

prompt: Holding her stopwatch, Wiktoria (to say) that the junior crew broke the record.
explanation_ru: Адресат речи не назван, поэтому после глагола сразу идёт придаточное с that — используем say (said).

prompt: I checked the cycling forum before riding to work. Freya wrote a post and (to tell) us the good news about the river path. She (to say) that the workers would finish the road surface by Thursday afternoon.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске есть адресат без предлога (told us), во втором адресат не указан перед that (said that).

prompt: Why didn't the pilot (to tell) the passengers why the plane couldn't take off?
explanation_ru: Глагол tell используется с одушевлённым дополнением без предлога (tell the passengers) и вопросительным словом why.

prompt: Marta put a note on the board because the professor ___ that the heating was broken.
explanation_ru: Без указания слушателя перед придаточным с that используется глагол said; tell без дополнения не употребляется.

prompt: "I actually prefer rainy autumn days to bright summer heat," Freya admitted to Liam. → Freya told …
answer: Freya told Liam that she actually preferred rainy autumn days to bright summer heat.
accepted_answers: Freya told Liam that she actually preferred rainy autumn days to bright summer heat.
Freya told Liam she actually preferred rainy autumn days to bright summer heat.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи после told сразу ставится адресат (Liam) без предлога to, а глагол сдвигается в прошедшее время.

prompt: Everyone stopped drinking tea when Ulrika tapped her spoon on a cup. She didn't (to say) a word at first, and we waited quietly. Then she (to tell) the whole office that we were getting a new quiet room.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение «not say a word» строится с say, а перед адресатом (the whole office) без предлога нужен глагол told.

prompt: Jada never (to tell) lies, so she admitted to Quinn that she had fallen asleep during the play.
explanation_ru: С существительным lies используется устойчивое сочетание tell lies (говорить неправду).

prompt: Una whispered backstage and told to Declan that she had lost her music page.
answer: Una whispered backstage and told Declan that she had lost her music page.
accepted_answers: Una whispered backstage and told Declan that she had lost her music page.
Una whispered backstage and said to Declan that she had lost her music page.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell предлог to перед именем человека не ставится: правильно «told Declan».

prompt: Celine bought three desk lamps online because she couldn't choose one, and she finally confessed this to her sister Fiona.
options: Celine told to Fiona that she had ordered three desk lamps online.
Celine said Fiona that she had ordered three desk lamps online.
Celine told Fiona that she had ordered three desk lamps online.
Celine told that she had ordered three desk lamps online.
explanation_ru: Только вариант «told Fiona that...» грамматически верен: tell требует прямого дополнения без предлога to.

prompt: Before the charity ride started, Gemma looked nervously at her front tyre. She finally (to tell) the truth and admitted that she had only checked her pump ten minutes earlier. Zeke laughed and (to say) he had a spare pump in his backpack.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении «tell the truth» нужен глагол told, а во втором предложении адресат не назван, поэтому ставим said.

prompt: Although the passengers were worried about the delay, the conductor (to say / to tell) nothing until the bridge track was completely clear.
explanation_ru: С местоимением nothing без указания слушателя используется глагол say (said nothing).

prompt: Nobody expected the thick sea fog to lift so early, so Maren was thrilled when she ___ the waiting passengers that boarding could begin.
explanation_ru: Перед прямым дополнением «the waiting passengers» без предлога используется глагол told.

prompt: Kasia nearly dropped her ruler when she opened her department email in the courtyard. She ran over to Radek to (to tell) him the exciting news about their bridge model. Before she could even (to say) hello, he guessed from her smile that they had won first place.
explanation_ru: В первом случае есть адресат без предлога (tell him), во втором — устойчивое приветствие «say hello».

prompt: Would you (to say / to tell) your manager if you accidentally printed ninety blank pages and hid them in your desk?
explanation_ru: После глагола сразу идёт адресат (your manager) без предлога to, поэтому выбираем tell.

prompt: Last night's screening started with a funny technical mistake when the wrong file played without subtitles. Nino sent an email this morning to (to say) sorry to everyone in the film club. She also (to tell) us that the next film would be checked twice before the show.
explanation_ru: Извинение выражается устойчивой фразой «say sorry (to someone)», а перед дополнением us без предлога используется told.
